label: champ_0060_rival_01
text: Before you take on a Gym, it’s good to see if you\ncan find the battle court in town and check it out.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0060_rival_02
text: It helps to see where the court is, what it’s made\nof—stuff like that. Those things might affect how\r\nthe battle goes![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0060_rival_04
text: I think it’s time I started introducing you to some\nof my harder hitters![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0060_rival_06
text: Let’s have us a fruitful battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0060_rival_07a
text: Man, you sure battle like someone with more\nthan two Gym Badges![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0060_rival_07b
text: Oof, sorry! That’s my bad for sending out such\nstrong Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0060_rival_08
text: Well, that was a great battle! Fruitful for sure![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0060_rival_09
text: I’d challenge you again literally right now...\nbut Champions have to be understanding.\r\nSo I’ll hang back and respect your time![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0060_rival_10
text: Keep on collecting badges for now, and let’s\nbattle next time we run into each other at a Gym![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0060_rival_12
text: I hope you get even stronger. Like, way...way...\nWAY stronger![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0060_rival_13
text: And once you do, you and me can just battle\nour hearts out![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0060_rival_14
text: All right, time for you to whup that Gym Test.\nThanks for this![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
